title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Use your helpers
hook: What does your assistant coach do during practice?
intro: Your assistant watches from the side.
statement: Two stations can double the reps.
q1: Do you split the team into stations with helpers —
q2: or run one drill together so everyone hears you?
q3: How many reps does each kid get?
t1: Both can work. But more kids stay busy
t2: when every adult runs a station.
cta: Coaches — how do you use assistants?
ctaLines: Two stations. Rotate every ten minutes. One voice.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What does your assistant coach do during practice?
You run every drill yourself. Your assistant watches from the side.
Two stations can double the reps.
Stations with helpers or one group. Every team is different.
How do you use assistants? Share your habit in the comments.
